home.tagline: Notes that work offline and sync across your devices.

showcase.title: Design showcase
showcase.intro: Base controls and tokens. This page exists for design review and will be removed.
showcase.bodySample: Body text is 14 px Geist. Labels are 13 px in the muted colour, and meta is 12 px mono.
showcase.noticeNeutral: Notes in the trash are deleted after 7 days.
showcase.noticeWarning: 3 changes have not been sent yet.
showcase.noteBody: Ink text on the note colour.

setup.title: Set up {name}
setup.description: Create the administrator account. You can invite other people afterwards.
setup.ssoDescription: Sign in with single sign-on. The first account becomes the administrator.

login.title: Sign in
login.invalid: The e-mail address or password is not correct.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask your administrator for a reset link.
login.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

invite.title: You are invited
invite.description: Create your account to get started.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: For {email}. You will be signed out on your other devices.

invite.title: Invite people
invite.description: The app sends no e-mail. Create a link and pass it on; it works once and expires after 7 days.

users.title: Users
users.resetLinkFor: Password reset link for {name}. Pass it on; it works once.
users.resetTotpMessage: Use this when they lost their phone and their recovery codes. They can set it up again.
users.deleteMessage: Their account, notes and images are deleted for good.

registration.title: Registration
registration.label: Allow anyone to create an account
registration.hint: When off, people can only join through an invite link.

storage.title: Storage
storage.defaultHint: Leave empty for unlimited. Admins are never limited.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.email_taken: An account with this e-mail address already exists.
errors.setup_done: This instance is already set up.
errors.registration_closed: Registration is closed. Ask an administrator for an invite.
errors.invalid_link: This link is invalid, has expired or has already been used.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.

errors.self_change: You cannot do this to your own account.

errors.login_expired: The sign-in took too long. Start again.
errors.token_not_allowed: API tokens cannot be used for this.
errors.oidc_failed: Single sign-on did not work. Try again.
errors.oidc_no_account: There is no account for you yet. Ask an administrator to create one.
errors.oidc_taken: That single sign-on account is already linked to another account.
errors.last_login_method: This is your only way to sign in.
errors.no_password: Accounts that use single sign-on get two-step verification from it.
errors.storage_full: Your storage is full. Delete notes or images to make room.

sync.signInAgain: Your session has ended. Your notes stay on this device; sign in again to sync them.
sync.rejected: The server refused {count} change. | The server refused {count} changes.

note.title: Title
note.deleteForeverMessage: It will be removed from all your devices. This cannot be undone.

empty.label: No notes with this label yet

trash.notice: Notes in the trash are deleted after {days} day. | Notes in the trash are deleted after {days} days.
trash.emptyMessage: All notes in the trash will be deleted forever, on all your devices.

labels.exists: A label with this name already exists.

pwa.installHint: Add this app to your home screen: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. Safari may otherwise remove your notes from this device after a week without use.

selection.trashed: {count} note moved to trash | {count} notes moved to trash
selection.deleteForeverTitle: Delete this note forever? | Delete {count} notes forever?

device.title: This device
device.intro: These settings apply to this browser only.
device.onDemandHint: Images stay on the server until you tap them. Saves data and space on phones.

password.title: Password
password.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions have been signed out.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.intro: Asks for a code from an authenticator app after your password.
totp.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
totp.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
totp.manual: Or enter this key by hand:
totp.saveCodes: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
totp.codesLeft: {count} recovery code left | {count} recovery codes left
totp.codeOrRecovery: Code from the app, or a recovery code

sso.title: Single sign-on ({provider})
sso.isLinked: Your account is linked to {provider}. You can sign in with it.
sso.notLinked: Link your {provider} account to sign in with it.
sso.onlyWay: This is your only way to sign in, so it cannot be unlinked.
sso.linked: Linked. You can now sign in with single sign-on.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: Tokens let scripts read or change your notes through the REST API. They cannot reach your account, security settings or administration.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.once: Copy the token now. It is not shown again.
tokens.revokeMessage: Scripts using this token stop working at once.

images.unsupported: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF images can be added.
images.unreadable: This image could not be read.
images.too_large: Images can be at most {mb} MB.

storage.full: Your storage is full. Delete notes or images to make room.
storage.fullNotice: Your storage is full: you can edit and delete notes, but not create notes or add images until you free up space.
